ValidationRule.description: Restricts edit access for the Financial_Advisor_Team__c field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Financial_Advisor_Team__c), NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator', $Permission.Systems_Custom_Permission, $Permission.Senior_Ops ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you need to change the financial advisor team, please reach out to your admin or ops teams.
